Definition: to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to disgrace, dishonour, be lightly esteemed, be dishonoured, be despised; 1a) (Niphal) to be dishonoured, be despised, be lightly esteemed; 1b) (Hiphil) to treat with contempt, dishonour, treat shamefully
